timing_scope: Three 65,536-byte XOR outputs. The direct Python XOR oracle runs seven times separately before preparation timing. preparation_ms constructs encoded bit-plane inputs on the CPU. decode_then_encode_wall_ms measures the FFmpeg hardware transcode. output_decode_ms decodes NVENC output using the CPU verification decoder. byte_reconstruction_ms assembles 24 bit-planes into three byte arrays. raw_input_to_bytes_ms includes preparation, transcode, output decode, and reconstruction, but excludes oracle runs and final comparison checks. These are one-run codec timings, not medians. No concurrent CUDA workload was running. Security engine hardware was not used.
